basics.name: Erfan Eivazi
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer | Backend Developer
basics.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience in software and web-based information system development, with a strong focus on backend engineering.
Experienced in business process analysis, software design and development across the SDLC, code quality, refactoring, maintainability, and long-term system evolution.
Hands-on experience in enterprise web applications, GIS, data processing, reporting systems, automation, and financial technology projects.
Experienced in Agile/Scrum teams, technical debt management, code reviews, DevOps collaboration, and mentoring software developers.

work.summary: Engineering software and information systems company developing web-based solutions for gas network analysis, simulation, monitoring, and data management.
highlights: Worked as a Senior Backend Developer across multiple software projects for the National Iranian Gas Company, including gas network simulation, gas consumption forecasting, and transmission network monitoring systems.
Developed the SGN gas network simulation platform, providing static and dynamic pressure-flow analysis for gas distribution engineers and analysts.
Contributed to the development of a gas consumption forecasting system using historical consumption data and temperature variations to support gas demand analysis.
Developed a logsheet data entry and monitoring system for recording station and control-valve information, emergency events, and operational reports for the gas transmission network.
Followed the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) within an Agile/Scrum development process.
Participated in requirements analysis and system design sessions together with the technical lead.
Performed code reviews and promoted Clean Code practices to improve code quality, readability, and maintainability.
Managed technical debt and planned continuous refactoring to maintain long-term extensibility and reduce maintenance costs.
Redesigned core software packages, including BackgroundTasks and InprocCore, using Clean Architecture principles.
Designed and developed a GIS Server compliant with OGC standards, supporting WFS, TMS, and WMS services.
Implemented five tools for validation and cleansing of geographic data according to GIS-Ready guidelines.
Developed a weather data ingestion module consuming data from the Iran Meteorological Organization FTP service and multiple external websites using web scraping techniques.
Developed a dynamic reporting system with an advanced QueryBuilder for generating comparative and aggregated reports based on user-selected fields.
Implemented Excel-based reporting workflows, including Excel export, template-based report generation, and macro-enabled templates.
Contributed to frontend development and web application tasks when required.
Supported and monitored DevOps processes and application delivery workflows.
Contributed to team knowledge sharing, mentoring, and improving collaboration within the development team.

Techs: C# | .NET | ASP.NET Core | SQL Server | Clean Architecture | CQRS | Microservices | NestJS | TypeORM | RabbitMQ | Angular | TypeScript | RxJS | GIS | OGC Standards | OpenLayers | GeoServer | Azure DevOps | Excel

work.summary: Web and software solutions company delivering business, recruitment, search, and mobile applications.
highlights: Designed and developed ParadiseHub, a multi-branch CRM and workspace management platform, using a fully NoSQL-based data model and supporting 11 distinct user roles.
Implemented flexible management of branch-specific workspace rental plans, including offices, desks, and seats for shared and dedicated workspaces.
Developed online rental and renewal workflows with payment gateway integration.
Implemented management and reservation of shared spaces such as meeting rooms and conference halls for each branch.
Developed branch-specific service management and sales workflows, including services such as breakfast and other member offerings.
Implemented member reservations and service purchases using wallet-based payments.
Developed financial management features including discounts, sales reports, and invoice management.
Implemented proposal submission and multi-stage application workflows for the company's accelerator program.
Designed and implemented an advanced query-building interface on Elasticsearch for searching large volumes of unstructured and filtered data.
Contributed as a Backend Developer to HR and recruitment products, including IranHR, a job-search engine, and other web-based systems.
Contributed to the development of the mobile game "Che-Kalameh" by working on backend functionality and data-related components.
Techs: JavaScript | Node.js | Express.js | Angular | MongoDB | Elasticsearch | REST APIs | Git
Built a job-search data collection system using web scraping to gather and process data from three major Iranian job websites.
Developed a job search engine with search and filtering capabilities for collected job postings.
Gained hands-on experience with the MEAN stack and practical software development workflows.
Studied core concepts of networking, database design, and Agile software development methodologies.
Ranked first in the bootcamp and was invited to join the FuTech Group as a software developer.
Techs: HTML | CSS | JavaScript | Node.js | Express.js | MySQL | Git

work.summary: Freelance engineering projects involving embedded systems, hardware control, monitoring software, and software-hardware integration.
highlights: Developed the motion-control and lighting software for an interactive Smart Wall advertising installation that detected pedestrians and dynamically reacted to their movement.
Upgraded a radiation monitoring application to support four simultaneous detectors and added configurable radiation alarm levels with command transmission to the hardware control panel.
Designed, built, and implemented a prototype access-control and silo-capacity monitoring system with its software user interface.
Designed and built a timer-based parking-gate control circuit with automatic closing, vehicle detection, and obstacle detection.
Worked across embedded programming, hardware interfaces, control systems, and software user interfaces.
Techs: C | C# | AVR | Arduino | Windows Forms | Serial Communication | RS-232 | Sensors | Servo Motors | LED Control

work.summary: Architecture and technology studio specializing in interactive technological installations and advertising structures.
highlights: Developed the control software for an interactive Smart Wall installation that used sensors to detect pedestrians and control movement and lighting effects.
Programmed embedded controllers to coordinate multiple actuators and LED lighting based on sensor input.
Collaborated with the architecture and fabrication team to integrate embedded software with the physical installation.
Techs: C | AVR MCU | Arduino | IR Sensors | Servo Motors | LED Lighting

work.summary: Manufacturer of radiometric measurement and radiation monitoring equipment.
highlights: Enhanced radiation monitoring software to support simultaneous monitoring of up to four connected detectors.
Implemented configurable radiation alarm thresholds and a software interface for sending control commands to the hardware panel.
Improved the operator workflow by enabling alarm configuration directly from the application instead of requiring direct hardware-panel access.
Worked on software-hardware communication and real-time monitoring interfaces.
Techs: C# | Windows Forms | USB | Serial Communication | RS-232
